lines.text:
Fractured pixels assemble.
The faint light within the deep-blue lattice resolves into an interface.

Terminal connected. The narrative channel is ready.

choices.content: I want to know what this place is.

lines.speaker: TERMINAL / SYSTEM ECHO
lines.text: This is the echo layer: the imprint an unfinished story leaves within the lattice.
A faint resonance travels up from deep within the lattice, like an answer from far away.

choices.text: What am I supposed to do?

lines.speaker: TERMINAL / SYSTEM ECHO
lines.text: Read every echo along the connections. If you wish to ask more, you may stay here.
